test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 12 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
This question is based on the following three-letter words:

(Left) ALL NTE PET ARE (Right)

If in each of the words, each letter is changed to the next letter in the English alphabetical order, how many words thus formed will have no vowel?
solution:
Given: (Left) ALL NTE PET ARE (Right)

Each letter is changed to the next letter in the English alphabetical order then,

 
 

 Word
 ALL
 NTE
 PET
 ARE
 
 

 After changed to next letter
 **BMM**
 OUF
 QFU
 **BSF**
 
 

 

After changed to the next letter in the English alphabetical order,

there are **"Two"** words having no vowels.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1"**.
